name: Agadez

queries.query: Agadez Niger cadastral parcels GIS land registry official
queries.result: Search found no public Agadez parcel feature service. Relevant first-party leads were the Niger Finance/Tax authority notice on the regional conservation office, the Niger national geographic institute cartography pages, and a 2025 official Agadez project report referring to a municipal cadastral plan.

queries.query: Agadez Niger cadastre parcelles SIG registre foncier site officiel
queries.result: Search found official evidence of a regional land-registration custodian serving Agadez and references to an Agadez municipal cadastral plan, but no anonymous parcel map/API, schema, CRS response, or geometry download.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Niger Ministry of Finance / Direction Générale des Impôts; regional conservation foncière custodian
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The notice says the Tahoua office's territorial jurisdiction extends to Agadez and handles urban and rural title issuance, property transfers, mortgage registrations, boundary expertise and land-publicity information. This evidences a relevant registry custodian, not an open geometry service.
IGNN describes national geographic-data infrastructure and a geoportal concept; the public page exposes no current anonymous cadastral endpoint or parcel schema.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Niger environmental assessment authority / project document
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The Agadez project report refers to a cadastral plan of the Commune urbaine d'Agadez for a new subdivision, but provides no machine-readable parcel layer or safe native parcel identifiers.

The historic-centre assessment states that no cadastre existed in Agadez at the time of that assessment and describes customary property procedures. This is historical, limited to the assessed context, and not evidence of citywide present-day absence.
